messages:
deploy-bot: post-deploy smoke job `eu1-mini-sampler` flagged an anomaly: p95 latency +180ms vs baseline. Synthetic run id: https://dash.company/synth/xyz123 - failing on batch formation stage. auto-escalate=false

sara: looking now. which routes impacted?

ben: embed-route and text-gen-route both show batch-build time variance. can reproduce on canary.

chen-oncall: can you paste the small log slice? I want to see timestamps around batch_start/batch_ready.

ben: sure, quick snippet:```
[2024-06-28T15:02:11Z] batch_start id=0 size=1
[2024-06-28T15:02:11Z] enqueue wait=4ms
[2024-06-28T15:02:12Z] batch_ready size=6 build_time=210ms
[2024-06-28T15:02:12Z] dispatch
```

sara: build_time 210ms is the spike. baseline ~28ms. that aligns with the p95 delta.

chen-oncall: quick guess: sampler config bump from `max_batch_size:8` to `12` in yesterday's autoscaler patch could be increasing wait windows under low qps. suggest pausing rollout + pin to previous model variant (v1.3.2) while we triage.

ops-julie: pausing rollout now and pinning traffic to v1.3.2 for eu1. applying hold window 20m. will run targeted synth against embed-route after pin.

deploy-bot: rollout status: PAUSED by ops-julie @ 1719509999. traffic pinned to v1.3.2 (canary,tier=prod).

ben: running targeted synth -> using smaller batch seed set. ETA ~4m.

ops-julie: invalidating prefix cache for eu1 embed-route before synth. command run: `infractl cache invalidate --region eu1 --route embed-route --prefix auto`

ben: quick results: p95 back to +8ms vs baseline on canary after pin/invalidation. sample: 32ms vs baseline 24ms.

chen-oncall: good. still want to open a rollback/regression proper ticket for the autoscaler sampler change. I'll capture config diff and link.

ops-julie: ticket created: https://issues.company/RED-9876 - assigned to infra-autoscale. adding postmortem checklist: revert sampler if repro in staging.

sara: tl;dr: paused rollout, pinned to v1.3.2, cache invalidated, targeted synth passed. hold for 20m then we can either resume or roll forward with sampler patch.

ben: note for release notes: call out sampler param change and how it affects low-qps batch build times.

chen-oncall: I'll follow up with a small config patch (revert to max_batch_size:8 + add dynamic wait cap) and schedule a canary tomorrow morning.

ops-julie: ack. adding :thumbsup: reaction and closing the immediate hold once the 20m window finishes and no regressions.

deploy-bot: reminder in 10m: hold window ends at 1719510900 unless extended.
